The film opens on one clear caller and one ordered recipient. The edit fades up from black over the source's first local half-second, and its half-second dissolve into the answer occupies the source's final local half-second. Their concurrent changes occupy the first two seconds; the altered relation remains available through the sixth.

EXT. PLAZA — DAY

SOLOIST stands at `plaza-center`, upright and separate from CHORUS, one hand down. CHORUS fills ordered rows behind the figure. The neutral ground leaves both silhouettes unbroken. There is no sound.

From 0.0 through 2.0 seconds, SOLOIST raises one hand to its authored endpoint while CHORUS advances 2 m as one formation. The figure does not step; the rows neither turn nor loosen. The required English accessibility-caption sidecar displays “The soloist raises the cue.” from global 1.5 through 3.0 seconds; it describes the visible action and adds no speech or sound. A faint neutral haze remains at constant low intensity in its declared far region throughout the six-second shot and never crosses the caller's silhouette.

From 2.0 through 6.0 seconds, the raised hand and completed formation hold. Begin the authored dissolve with the hand at its endpoint and CHORUS exactly 2 m nearer than at the opening.
